messages:
Taylor P: Morning! I'm Taylor, joined today. Can't access the team's Datadog dashboard and Grafana panels. Trying to recreate a cross-tool overview for latency/err rates. Who do I ping for okta/dev team access?
Infra-Maya: welcome! You need observability-read for viewing and datadog-write if you want to create monitors. For Grafana importing add grafana-import. Fill https://forms.redwood.com/obs-access and list exact dashboard UIDs and desired folders.
Taylor P: I already submitted and included dashboard UIDs and "team-taylor" folder. Got a 403 when clicking import in Grafana.
SRE-Rohan: 403 usually means Okta group hasn't propagated. Logout+SSO login first. If still 403, send me the screenshot and I'll escalate. Also, importing into prod requires Ops ticket.
Taylor P: Screenshot attached in the form. Also curious: how do we ensure Datadog monitors and Grafana panels show the same p95 metric? Any canonical metric name?
Observability-Amy: We standardize on trace.http.request.duration.percentile_95 for traces and http.server.duration:percentile_95 for metrics. Use tag env:prod|staging and service:<svc>. Dashboards in Grafana should point to prometheus or traces datasource accordingly.
Devex-bot: Docs: https://docs.redwood.com/observability/metrics-naming and https://docs.redwood.com/observability/datadog#metric-names. Include the metric name and query in your access form to speed approvals.
SRE-Rohan: For alert routing, add desired Slack channel in the form and the severity. We map @pagerduty for criticals, and channels for warnings. If you want GitHub auto-ticketing from Sentry, request the Sentry project role too.
Taylor P: Re-logged and can view Grafana now. Imported into dev folder. Will not touch prod. Thanks everyone!
Infra-Maya: Nice. Ping in a dm if you want us to run the prod import after review.
Taylor P: Will do. Appreciate the help :rocket:
